text: in Steering, push the right stick fully out and hold, with and without a driver held: no turn-assist speed-up, and the gyro keeps aiming while the stick turns
hold R1, hold a trigger (firing), push the right stick out, let go of R1: you're back in fallback (WASD), with no W stuck on. In the alternative: hold R2, hold a bumper
in a Steering stick Double Tap window (flick the left stick while driving), pull a trigger: the mouse button still fires. In the alternative, the bumpers
outside Steering, turn assist and gyro-off-while-turning work as before
(Modifier 2, stick touch): hold L1 then R1, miss both releases, touch either stick: back to Base, typing works. Repeat with Gyro on (you return to Gyro) and R1 first

(Modifier 2 held, stick touch): hold L1 and R1 and rest a thumb on each stick: nothing clears, Modifier 2 keys still work. Repeat holding only one bumper of a stuck Modifier 2: nothing clears until that bumper is released too

(cursor, one step): hold L1 for 300 ms (cursor), miss the release, push the right stick to the edge once: cursor and modifier are both gone in that one push (before: cursor first, modifier on the repeat). Repeat with R1 and with the left stick
(Steering Modifier 2): in Steering hold R1 then L1, miss R1's release only (keep L1 held), touch a stick: nothing clears. Release L1: back to Steering
(rocking): hold L1, add R1, wait 200 ms, let go of L1, press L1 again, wait, let go of R1, let go of L1: no scroll at any point, Base at the end. Repeat starting with R1, and with Gyro on
(taps): tap L1 twice quickly: scroll down. Hold L1 and press A, let go, tap L1 at once: no scroll. Hold L1 and tap R1 within 200 ms: Gyro toggles
(stuck, still clears): miss the release of L1 alone, of Start's Fn layer, and of a Steering driver, then press A or touch a stick: each clears
(menu): hold Start, push a stick (guard), release: Tab or the window as before; hold Start past 200 ms for Fn, release: Fn gone, nothing left behind
(the fix): hold the left stick up for about 1 s, roll to A or D without recentring and hold for 3 s: the pulses stop on A or D and Steering stays. Repeat from down
(exit): hold the left stick up: W, pulses from the start, and Steering exits with one beep at about 1.5 s. Repeat with down and S
(early release): hold up for 1 s, recentre, hold up again: the exit comes 1.5 s after the second push, not sooner

(after A or D): hold A for 3 s, roll up and hold: the exit comes about 1.5 s after reaching up. An instant exit means the timer counted the time on A; an exit near 3 s means the reset on the edge restarted it
(diagonal): hold up-left: W and A together, pulses carry on, exit at 1.5 s
(driver): hold up, press R1 before 1.5 s: the pulses stop, no exit, and the R1 modifier map is up. Release R1 with the stick still up: note whether W and the pulses come back

(entry): enter Steering with the stick centred, push up and hold: W with no pulse and no exit until the stick has been back to centre once (D9 in 90.10). Repeat entering with the stick already held up

(menu while holding up): hold up, tap Start: one Tab, W carries on, and the exit still comes 1.5 s after the push. Hold Start for 1 s: Tab held, no Fn. Recentre, push A: no pulse. Repeat with Select (Escape)
(menu held, then push up): hold Start with the stick centred, push up and hold for 3 s: W, no pulses, and Steering stays. Release Start: Fn or Tab as usual

(Entry Guard): enter Steering and leave the stick centred: Start and Select type Tab and Escape, with no Fn and no leave gesture. Push the stick out and back once, or press a driver: Start's tap and Fn come back
(desktop): apply the layout to the desktop configuration and repeat F1 and F2

(gate 1, stick inheritance from the middle of the stack): hold the left stick out, then hold Start (the guard lands), click and release the stick, release Start: Steering is on (R1 drives W). A Q typed at the click means the click skipped the Entry Point under the guard
(gate 1, Fn): hold Start past 200 ms so Fn is up, click and release the left stick, release Start: Steering is on

(gate 2, edge Release in a layer added with the stick already out): hold Start, flick the left stick out and back inside 200 ms, keep holding Start for 1 s, then press a face button: an F-key means the guard came off on the edge Release and Fn followed. If there is no F-key, release Start: a silent release means the guard never came off (gate 2 fails, the Tap Cover landed on it); a Tab means the guard came off but the Fn delay didn't come back (assumption 6)
(stick already out): hold the left stick north, then hold Start for 500 ms: no `\` is typed, and the release is silent. A `\` means the guard landed after the 200 ms Fn delay
(tap with a stick out): hold the left stick north, tap Start: one Tab

(eaten delay comes back): push both sticks out while holding Start, recentre the right one before 200 ms, keep holding for 1 s, release Start: silent. A Tab means the first guard's Tap Cover delay didn't come back (assumption 6)

each gesture from Base and from `Gyro`: Start + LS click enters Steering; Select + RS click, Start + RS click and Select + LS click clear to Base and keep `Gyro`. The stick click is released first, then the menu button. Every one of them beeps and gives a strong haptic pulse on the menu release, with no on-screen notification
(clear): in Steering, each of the four gestures leaves it, with the beep and pulse on the menu release; `Gyro` stays as it was
(cancel): hold Start, click and hold the left stick, release Start first, then the click: no Steering. Note what the click's release does

(missed release): in each transition, release the menu button while the Steam menu is open, close it: everything is blocked until the next tap of either menu button, which ends the transition (a Start tap in the cross transition enters Steering)
(guards): guard on and off for each stick, and both together; with a guard on, a quick menu tap types Tab or Escape, and a 200 ms hold or a thumb lift makes the release silent
(stale guard): with a stick out, release the menu button while the Steam menu is open, close it: touching a stick clears the guard, and the next menu tap behaves normally

(accepted): under the menu Tap Cover, bump the other menu button: the cover returns within about 200 ms, and a release inside that gap types its key. With a stick out and no cover yet, a bump of the other menu button types its key
(K1 reworded): hold Start, press Select before Fn is up: exactly one Backspace, repeating while held. Mirror for Enter
the camera stick is dead while a menu button is held, and comes back on release

(mouse buttons through a window): tap L1, or flick the left stick while driving, and pull a trigger inside the 150 ms window: the mouse button fires. Repeat with the right stick past the ramp threshold first, so `Gyro Off Ramp Up` is underneath: the mouse button still fires. Then hold a trigger and tap L1: note whether the click is interrupted when the window lands and when it times out. In the alternative, the same with the bumpers inside a Steering window
(menu): with no driver held, tap Start: one Tab and Steering stays; hold Start: Fn. Hold R1 and tap Start: Tab; Select: Escape
(hold exit): replaced by F1 to F5 in 90.11

(modifier and roll): hold R1, hold the left stick up: the R1 modifier map. Roll to the side: A or D steers and the map stays until the stick is back at centre. Roll straight to down inside 250 ms: the L1 modifier map takes over
(stick first): hold the left stick up, then press R1: the modifier map is there at once; held 250 ms, recentring is silent; recentred sooner, one scroll

(double taps): flick up and back: one scroll about 150 ms after centre. Flick, then flick and hold: repeating scroll; releasing stops it and adds nothing. Flick up, then push down inside 150 ms: no scroll, the down modifier map. Flick, then push sideways inside 150 ms: A or D at once and the scroll still lands at 150 ms
(W and S through the window): hold a driver, flick the stick once: W or S carries on through the window and after it. Release the driver inside the window: back on `Steering` with plain WASD
(other driver in the window): flick the stick, bump the other driver inside 150 ms: its key for that moment, no two-modifier map, and driving carries on

(mapped buttons): in a modifier map, press a face button: its key, and recentring is then silent. Missed release: in a modifier map, release the driver while the Steam menu is open, close it, press a face button: the steering branch clears
(entry with the stick centred): enter Steering with the stick centred, push up and hold: W with no exit warning until the stick has been back to centre once

(early path): hold Start and press Select within 300 ms, before Fn is up: Backspace types on that first press, repeats while Select is held, and stops cleanly on release with no stuck key. Then release Start: no Tab. Mirror with Select then Start for Enter (no Escape)
with Fn up (hold Start past 300 ms), Select types Backspace on every press and repeats while held. Mirror for Enter

(accepted): hold Start, press and keep holding Select, lift Start first. Select falls through to Base and opens Menu Left; releasing it within 300 ms sends Escape. Mirror: Tab. Confirm this is the only extra output, and that releasing Select first never sends anything extra
other Fn keys behave the same way (hold Start, hold LB for F10, lift Start: LB becomes the L1 modifier)

every layer still does what it did: spot-check a modifier, Mod 2, both menus' Fn keys, the Transition Sets and steering entry. The two removed layers shifted later runtime IDs, so this must be a fresh load

hold LS up past 250 ms, lift the left thumb, put it back: LST layers clear, the stick stays consumed until center, no phantom scroll

both variants load without error; every layer's sources look the same as 90.5 in the editor
